//: Used in: components/billing/MonthlyTopUpSheet (monthlyTopUpSheet namespace). The recurring rule only — turn on, change amount, turn off. ACTIVATION NEVER CHARGES: the first charge is the next 1st, so no key here quotes a pay-now amount. Flow copy only; the method identity, pitch, schedule line, status words and generic verbs come from the shared billing namespace.
promptTitle: Want to start every month with the same budget?
promptBody: Set up monthly credit top-up and we'll automatically top your credits up from your card on the first day of each month.
amountQuestion: How much do you want each month?
consent: Charge my saved card on the 1st of each month to top my credits up to {{amount}}
disclosure: By turning this on you authorize a charge to your saved card on the 1st of each month, for the difference between your credits and {{amount}}. Cancel anytime.
footnote: Secured by Stripe. Change or cancel anytime.
updateNote: The new amount takes effect on the 1st of next month. Nothing is charged now.
retryNote: Your last charge failed. We'll retry your card shortly. Update the card if it should keep failing.
cardFailedNote: Your card declined several times, so the monthly top-up is paused. Update your card, then turn it back on.
verifyingCardBody: This usually takes a few seconds.
unverifiedCardTitle: We couldn't confirm the card yet
unverifiedCardBody: If the link went through, you can turn on the monthly top-up from Wallet in a moment.
disableBody: We'll stop topping up your credits each month. Your current credits stay, and your card stays saved.
successBody: Nothing was charged now. We'll top your credits up to {{amount}} on the 1st of next month.
